_comment: PROTOS / ALFRED MCP CONFIG. Protos (aion:1) is the Alfred fork SEED — chain-executor forks
this warm session, so every chain window inherits what is configured here. Its cwd is this
directory, reached as ~/Claude/Alfred-Dev (a SYMLINK to it; the launcher enters via the
symlink so Claude Code does not see the monorepo .git).
THIS IS A SEPARATE FILE FROM THE ROOT .mcp.json ON PURPOSE — it carries mcp-gateway, which
is protos-specific (dockerised memory/fetch gateway) and exists in no other lane. Everything
else is deliberately kept in step with the root config; if you change one, check the other.
--watch PATHS ARE ABSOLUTE, AND MUST STAY ABSOLUTE. mcp-hot-reload resolves watch globs
against process.cwd(), and this lane's cwd is alfred/ — not the repo root. The root config's
RELATIVE pattern ('infrastructure/rag-service/...') would resolve to alfred/infrastructure/...
here, which does not exist, so hot reload would silently watch NOTHING while still appearing
configured. That is worse than having no wrapper at all.
PER-LANE VALUES ARE ${VAR:-default} SO A CHAIN FORK CAN OVERRIDE THEM. The launcher exports
NONE of these for Protos (unlike genie/jaques/urist), so the defaults below are what Protos
actually gets. Verified 2026-08-25: GRAPHITI_GROUP_ID is absent from the tmux server env, the
session env, and the live process env, so the default reliably fires.
GRAPHITI_GROUP_ID DEFAULTS TO protos-core AND MUST NEVER DEFAULT TO jarvis-core. Protos is the
lane that gets forked FROM; pointing it at jarvis-core would pollute W0's graph with every
chain's writes. The ${VAR:-} form is also the lever for the open question of N chains sharing
one namespace: if that mixing is unwanted, set GRAPHITI_GROUP_ID per fork in chain-executor.sh
rather than editing this file.
SECRETS USE BARE ${VAR} WITH NO DEFAULT, DELIBERATELY. A default would re-embed the secret in
a tracked file AND make a failed export invisible, because the server would authenticate fine
even when the export silently did nothing. This file IS tracked (2026-08-25) — before
committing a change here, sweep it against .claude/secrets/credentials.yaml.
